closure_definition: Smallest operator set containing the seed generators {i*H_term} and closed under the commutator [.,.]; its dimension is the closure size, measured by vectorized-rank growth.
known_invariant_anchor: n qubits with local control + an entangling generator close to su(2^n), real dim 2^(2n)-1 (universality of local+entangling control). Decoupled => block sum of su(2)'s.
object: Dynamical Lie algebra (operator-algebra closure) generated by the terms of a joint system+environment Hamiltonian under iterated commutators.
system_environment_partition: System = wire 1; environment = remaining wires. Local control {X,Z} on every wire is always seeded; the coupling term is the only variable under test.

tools_used.Z3: load_bearing — DERIVES predicted closure dim from free structural vars (n free; D=2^n via Z3_mk_power; pred = coupled ? D^2-1 : 3n) and proves measured==pred by refuting its negation (per-case UNSAT). A broken measurement makes the query SAT (verdict flips). Free-variable derivation, not a literal-vs-literal tautology.

verdict.honesty_note: Closure dimension is MEASURED by independent-commutator rank growth, not planted. Each is checked against the independently-derived special-unitary invariant 2^(2n)-1 (or its block-factorized sum when decoupled). Two kill-controls (decoupled H_coupling=0; rate-matched wrong-structure local op with identical Frobenius norm 2.0) both fail to grow the closure into the joint sector; only genuinely entangling couplings (ZZ, XX, ZZ-chain) do. Z3 is load-bearing: it DERIVES the predicted dim from the structural inputs over FREE variables (n free; D=2^n computed in-solver via Z3_mk_power; pred = coupled ? D^2-1 : 3n) and proves measured==pred by refuting the negation, so every genuine case is UNSAT (proven). A deliberately-broken measurement (dim_cpl-1) makes the same query SAT, confirming the kill fires on bad data. This is a free-variable derivation, NOT a literal-vs-literal tautology.

z3_anchor.encoding: free n; D=2^n derived in-solver (Z3_mk_power); pred = coupled ? D*D-1 : n*3; assert measured != pred; UNSAT => proven, SAT => kill
